text: In F. Scott Fitzgerald's *The Great Gatsby*, narrator Nick Carraway moves to Long Island in the summer of 1922 and becomes entangled in the world of his mysterious, fabulously wealthy neighbor Jay Gatsby, who throws lavish parties in hopes of reuniting with Daisy Buchanan, the woman he loved and lost five years earlier—now married to the brutish old-money aristocrat Tom Buchanan. Gatsby and Daisy begin an affair, but tensions erupt when Tom exposes Gatsby's shady past and Daisy, driving Gatsby's car, accidentally kills Tom's mistress Myrtle Wilson. After Gatsby takes the blame for the accident and is murdered by Myrtle's grieving husband, few mourners attend his funeral, and Nick leaves New York disillusioned with the hollow glamour and moral decay of the Jazz Age.
